# Test fixtures

**Synthetic data only.** Names, ids, dates and places here are invented ("John Example", `XXXX-XXX`).

Never paste a real FamilySearch response, token, cookie, e-mail, phone number or PIN into this folder,
not even "just for a moment": it stays in Git history. If you need the shape of a new field, copy the
*structure* and replace every value. See `SDD/2-requirements/2-non-functional.md` (NFR-05).
